The parameters in extendConfigs are described as follows.

| Name | Type | Required | Example Value | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ---- | ---- | ---- |
| extendConfigs | Array |  |  | Database Collector extension configuration. |
| └configType | String | Yes | collectorElasticsearchForKibana | Configuration type. | └type | String | No | ECSInstanceId | Machine type where the Database Collector is deployed. Valid values: ECSInstanceId (ECS), ACKCluster (Kubernetes container). This parameter is required when **configType** is **collectorDeployMachine**. |
| └instanceType | String | No | elasticsearch | Instance type specified for the Database Collector Output. Valid values: elasticsearch, logstash. This parameter is required when **configType** is **collectorTargetInstance**. |

CreateILMPolicy.requestParamsDescription:
## RequestBody
|Parameter|Type|Example Value|Required|Description|
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
|name|String|my-policy|Yes|The name of the index lifecycle policy.|
|phases|Map||No|The content of the index lifecycle policy. For more information, see **Data structure of the phases field**.|

**Data structure of the phases field**
|Parameter|Type|Example Value|Required|Description|
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
|{key}|Struct||No|The current lifecycle phase. The following three phases are supported: hot (hot data phase, during which the index is actively updated and queried); cold (cold data phase, during which the index is no longer updated and is rarely queried. The data must remain searchable, but slower query performance is acceptable); delete (delete phase, during which the index is no longer needed and can be safely deleted).|
|minAge|String|30d|No|The time required for an index to reach the target phase.|
|actions|Struct||No|The policy settings for the current phase. For more information, see **Data structure of the actions field**.|

**Data structure of the actions field**
|Parameter|Type|Example Value|Required|Description|
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
|rollover|Struct||No|The rollover operation for the hot phase. For more information, see **Data structure of the rollover field**.|
|setPriority|Struct||No|The index priority for the hot or cold phase. For more information, see **Data structure of the setPriority field**.|
|allocate|Struct||No|The allocation operation for the cold phase. For more information, see **Data structure of the allocate field**.|
|delete|Struct|{}|No|The delete index operation. When the delete phase is enabled, this property must be included and must be a null object.|

**Data structure of the rollover field**
|Parameter|Type|Example Value|Required|Description|
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
|maxAge|String|30d|No|The time threshold that triggers index rollover. At least one of maxAge, maxDocs, and maxSize must be specified. Unit: d (days) or h (hours).|
|maxDocs|Integer|10000|No|The document count threshold that triggers index rollover.|
|maxSize|String|50gb|No|The index size threshold that triggers index rollover. At least one of maxAge, maxDocs, and maxSize must be specified. Unit: MB or GB.|

**Data structure of the setPriority field**
|Parameter|Type|Example Value|Required|Description|
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
|priority|Integer|100|No|The default priority of the current node.|

**Data structure of the allocate field**
|Parameter|Type|Example Value|Required|Description|
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
|numberOfReplicas|Integer|1|No|The number of replicas to allocate. If this parameter is set, the default value is 1. When used together with migrate and automatic migration is enabled, replica allocation is performed by default.|
|require|Struct||No|Optional setting, available only in clusters with hot and cold data separation architecture. For more information, see **Data structure of the require field**.|

**Data structure of the require field**
|Parameter|Type|Example Value|Required|Description|
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |

EstimatedLogstashRestartTime.requestParamsDescription:
## Request body

You can configure the following parameters in the request body to specify information about the restart. 
| Parameter | Type | Required | Example | Description |
 | ---- | ---- | ---- | ---- | 
| restartType| String | No | instance|The restart type. Valid values: instance and nodeIp. Default value: instance. |
 | nodes| List<String> | No| \["127.0.xx.xx"] |The IP addresses of the nodes that you want to restart. This parameter is required if you set restartType to nodeIp. |
 | blueGreenDep| Boolean | No | false |Specifies whether to perform a blue-green restart. This parameter is required if you set restartType to instance. Default value: false. |
 | batch| Integer | No| 25.0 | The concurrency at which the cluster is forcibly restarted. The default value of this parameter is 1 divided by the total number of nodes in the cluster. | 
| batchUnit| String | No | percent |The unit of the value for the batch parameter. Default value: percent. |

*   If you set the restartType parameter to instance, you do not need to configure the blueGreenDep parameter.

    *   If you set the force parameter to true, you must set the batch parameter to a value that is greater than 0 and less than or equal to 100. Otherwise, the system reports the RestartBatchValueError error.
    *   If you set the force parameter to false, the default value of the batch parameter is 0. If you set the batch parameter to a value other than 0, the system reports the NormalRestartNotSupportBatch error.

*   If you set the restartType parameter to nodeIp, you do not need to configure the batch parameter.

    *   If the nodes parameter is not configured, the system reports a parameter configuration error.
    *   If you set the blueGreenDep parameter to true, the system performs a blue-green restart. If you set the blueGreenDep parameter to false, the system performs a normal restart.

Sample code:

    {
        "restartType":"nodeIp",
        "nodes": ["172.16.xx.xx"],
        "blueGreenDep":true
    }

GetClusterDataInformation.title: GetClusterDataInformation
GetClusterDataInformation.requestParamsDescription:
The request parameters is empty, but the RequestBody parameter is required.

You must specify the cluster information by setting the following parameters in RequestBody:

| Parameter | Type | Required | Example | Description |
| --------- | ---- | -------- | ------- | ----------- |
| dataSourceType | String | Yes | elasticsearch | The type of the cluster. Default value: elasticsearch. |
| endpoint | String | No | http://10.01.xx.xx | The public domain name of the cluster. This parameter must be specified when the network environment of the source cluster is a public network. |
| instanceId | String | No | es-cn-09k1rnu3g0002**** | The ID of the Elasticsearch instance. This parameter is required when the network environment of the source cluster is an Alibaba Cloud Elasticsearch cluster. |
| vpcInstancePort | Integer | No | 9200 | The access port number of the cluster. The source cluster network environment is required when the Alibaba Cloud Elasticsearch cluster or Alibaba Cloud ECS Service User-created cluster is used. |
| vpcId | String | No | vpc-2ze59tt67m3nzkko9**** | The ID of the VPC to which the cluster belongs. The source cluster network environment is required when the Alibaba Cloud Elasticsearch cluster or Alibaba Cloud ECS Service User-created cluster is used. |
| vpcInstanceId | String | No | es-09k1rnu3g0002****-worker | The instance ID or Server Load Balancer (SLB) ID of the current cluster. This parameter is required when the network environment of the source cluster is an Alibaba Cloud Elasticsearch cluster. |
| username | String | No | elastic | The username that is used to connect to the cluster. |
| password | String | No | xxxxxx | The password that is used to connect to the cluster. |
| index | String | No | product | The name of the destination index. |
| type | String | No | default | The type of the destination index. |
> - If the index is empty, you can check whether the Elasticsearch cluster can be connected. If the connectivity is available, the indices field in the returned results is not null.
- If the index is not empty, you can get the information about the settings and mappings under the current index.
- If the type is not empty, you can obtain the routing field of the current type.

The parameters vary depending on the network environment of the source cluster.

- Public network cluster: enter one or more parameters, including endpoint. Example:```
{
         "dataSourceType": "elasticsearch",
         "endpoint": "http://es-cn-npk1shyiq000d****.public.elasticsearch.aliyuncs.com:9200",
         "username": "elastic",
         "password": "xxxxxx",
         "index": "default",
         "type": "default"
         }
```
- Alibaba Cloud ECS Service self-built cluster: Enter the following parameters: vpcInstancePort, vpcId, and vpcIp. For example:```
{
            "dataSourceType": "elasticsearch",
            "vpcId":"vpc-2ze55voww95g82gak****",
            "vpcInstancePort": "9200",
            "vpcIp": "10.12.xx.xx",
            "username" : "elastic",
            "password" : "xxxxxx",
            "index":  "product",
            "type" : "default"
       }
```
- Alibaba Cloud Elasticsearch cluster: specify the parameters: vpcInstancePort, vpcId, vpcInstanceId, and instanceId. The sample code is as follows:```
{
        "dataSourceType" : "elasticsearch",
        "vpcId":"vpc-2ze55voww95g82gak****",
        "vpcInstancePort" : "9200",
        "vpcInstanceId" : "es-cn-09k1rnu3g0002****-worker",
        "instanceId" : "es-cn-oew1oxiro000f****",
        "username" : "elastic",
        "password" : "xxxxxx",
        "index":  "product",
        "type" : "default"
     }
```

GetEmonMonitorData.title: Query Grafana Metric Monitoring Data for an Instance
GetEmonMonitorData.requestParamsDescription:
## RequestBody

| Parameter Name | Type | Required | Example Value | Description |
| -------- | -------- | -------- | -------- | -------- |
| start | Long | Yes | 1522127381471 | The UNIX timestamp indicating the start time of metric monitoring. Unit: milliseconds. |
| expression | String | No | a+b | The expression for querying metric data. |
| queries | List | Yes |  | The conditions for metric queries. |
| └ id | String | No | a | If the `expression` parameter is used, the `queries` JSON array describes the metrics involved in the expression. The `id` represents the algebraic symbol of each metric in the expression, while the actual metric name is specified in each element of the `queries` array. |
| └ metric | String | Yes | elasticbuild.elasticsearch.source.total_doc_count | Metric Name. |
| └ aggregator | String | Yes | sum | The aggregation method applied to the metric across dimensions defined by tags. This performs group-by operations on the specified tags and applies aggregation functions such as sum, avg, max, or min. |
| └ downsample | String | Yes | avg | The time-based aggregation method for the metric. This reduces the time-series resolution within the [start, end] time window—for example, aggregating from 20-second precision to 1-minute, 10-minute, or 1-hour precision—automatically adjusted based on the size of the time window. |
| └ tags | Map | Yes | [env, dev] | The labels used for querying metrics. The format is [key, value]. The key must be explicitly specified, and the value supports wildcard characters, which allows returning multiple time series that match the condition. |
| └ granularity | String | Yes | 1m | The time precision for metric queries. The range is [start, end]. Unit: milliseconds. |
| limit | String | Yes | "100 " | Limits the size of the returned result set. If empty, there is no limit, and all queried data is returned. This is typically used when wildcard characters are used in tag values, which may result in a very large result set. |
| end | String | Yes | 1522129151000 | The UNIX timestamp indicating the end time of metric monitoring. Unit: milliseconds. |

> └ indicates a nested parameter.

Sample request:

```
{
    "start": 1522127381471, 
    "queries": [
    {
        "metric": "elasticbuild.elasticsearch.source.total_doc_count",
        "aggregator": "sum",
        "downsample": "avg", 
        "tags": {
          "taskName": "et-testtsk",
          "userId":"123456" 
        }, 
        "granularity": "1m" 
      }
    ], 
    "limit": "",  
    "end": 1522129151000
}
```

**Data structure description of the phases field**
|Parameter|Type|Example Value|Required|Description|
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
|{key}|Struct| |No|The current lifecycle phase. The following three phases are supported: hot (hot data phase, where the index is actively updated and queried); cold (cold data phase, where the index is no longer updated and is rarely queried. The data still needs to be searchable, but slower query performance is acceptable); delete (delete phase, where the index is no longer needed and can be safely deleted).|
|minAge|String|30d|No|The time required for an index to reach the target phase.|
|actions|Struct| |No|Policy settings for the current phase. For more information, see **Data structure description of the actions field** below.|

**Data structure description of the actions field**
|Parameter|Type|Example Value|Required|Description|
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
|rollover|Struct| |No|Rollover operation for indices in the hot phase. For more information, see **Data structure description of the rollover field** below.|
|setPriority|Struct| |No|Index priority in the hot or cold phase. For more information, see **Data structure description of the setPriority field** below.|
|allocate|Struct| |No|Allocation operation for the cold phase. For more information, see **Data structure description of the allocate field** below.|
|delete|Struct| {} |No|Delete index operation. When the delete phase is enabled, this property must be included and must be a null object.|

|Parameter|Type|Example Value|Required|Description|
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |

|maxDocs|Integer|10000|No|The document count threshold that triggers index rollover.|
|maxSize|String|50gb|No|The index size threshold that triggers index rollover. At least one of maxAge, maxDocs, and maxSize must be specified. Unit: MB or GB.|

**Data structure description of the setPriority field**
|Parameter|Type|Example Value|Required|Description|
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |

| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
|numberOfReplicas|Integer|1|No|Specifies the number of replicas to allocate. If set, the default value is 1. When used together with migrate and automatic migration is enabled, replica allocation is performed by default.|
|require|Struct| |No|Optional setting, available only in clusters with hot and cold data separation architecture. For more information, see **Data structure description of the require field** below.|

ModifyInstanceMaintainTime.summary: Invoke ModifyInstanceMaintainTime to change and enable the maintenance window for an instance.
ModifyInstanceMaintainTime.description:
Before invoking this API, note the following:  
- Before scheduled maintenance, Alibaba Cloud sends text messages and emails to the contacts associated with your Alibaba Cloud account. Please check your messages and email inbox.  
- On the day of maintenance, to ensure stability throughout the maintenance procedure, the instance enters a "pending" status before the maintenance window begins. While in this status, access to the cluster and query operations (such as Performance Monitoring) are unaffected. However, cluster modification operations (such as upgrade or restart) are temporarily unavailable.  
- During the maintenance window, transient connection disruptions may occur. Ensure your application implements a reconnection mechanism.
